scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplied; exact finite-state checks corroborate only. No independent audit or exhaustive historical priority determination has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to zero-temperature single-site Glauber dynamics on K_{m,n} with odd m,n>=3 and strictly opposed initial part majorities, uniform positive couplings and unit-rate clocks. It determines consensus probabilities and a fixed-ratio Gaussian window, not arbitrary graphs or absorption-time moments.
title: Opposed-part consensus in zero-temperature bipartite Glauber dynamics: an exact beta race and a Gaussian reversal window
